projectDescription: Myna is an AI-powered SMS and messaging agent platform that automates sales outreach, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling through conversational AI campaigns.
keyFeatures: AI SMS and multi-channel messaging agent for automated sales outreach
Configurable agent personas with tone, humor, formality, and empathy controls
Automated lead qualification with custom qualification goals and rules
Appointment scheduling and calendar integration via Google Calendar and HighLevel
Multi-step campaign management with follow-up sequences and intro/final messages
GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM integration for contact sync and workflow automation
Twilio SMS integration for phone number management and message delivery
Knowledge base with RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) for agent context
Playground for testing agent responses before going live
Agency mode with multi-workspace management and credit allocation
AI-toggle for verbatim vs LLM-generated messages with merge field personalization
Contact custom fields, tags, and activity tracking
publicApiSurface: GET/POST /admin/agents — list and create AI agents
POST /admin/start_campaign — start a campaign for a contact
POST /playground/generate — test agent response in playground
GET/POST /myna-crm/highlevel — GoHighLevel OAuth and contact sync
